svg.title: Acne from the vertex snap
svg.desc: Two top-down visibility maps of a bare floor under a point light, white where lit. With 6.8's reach, stripes of acne run along one cube face; with half a texel added for the rasterizer's vertex snapping, the floor is clean.
svg.text: A bare floor under a bulb, from above: white is lit, black is acne
nothing casts a shadow here, so every dark mark is the map disagreeing with itself; grey is beyond the bulb's range
+ half a texel for the vertex snap: 0
